title: Design for continuity by keeping one scene, one character, and one location…
content: Design for continuity by keeping one scene, one character, and one location across shots, and use slower pacing (avoid fast cuts/random camera changes) to help Seedance maintain a continuous narrative across separate prompts.
tips: Design for continuity by keeping one scene, one character, and one location across shots, and use slower pacing (avoid fast cuts/random camera changes) to help Seedance maintain a continuous narrative across separate prompts.

es.content:
Diseña para la continuidad manteniendo una escena, un personaje y una ubicación a lo largo de los planos, y utiliza un ritmo más lento (evita cortes rápidos/cambios de cámara aleatorios) para ayudar a Seedance a mantener una narrativa continua a través de diferentes prompts.
